bar.text: We use necessary cookies. With your consent we additionally measure visits and attribute campaigns.

sheet.title: Privacy
sheet.intro: Necessary cookies keep you signed in and protect forms. Everything else stays off until you switch it on here.

necessary.label: Necessary
necessary.description: Sign-in, forms, this setting. Always on.

measurement.label: Measurement
measurement.description: Example Analytics counts visits; cookies up to 400 days.

marketing.label: Marketing
marketing.description: Example Ads measures whether an ad led to a request; data may be transferred to the US; cookies up to 90 days.

embeds.label: Embedded content
embeds.description: Videos from Example Video set their own cookies when loaded.

video.label: Video from Example Video
video.description: Example Video sets its own cookies and may transfer data abroad.
